reviewed_by: Codex focused review of Nebula assistant product-help and packaged-index diff
reason: The dedicated Nebula assistant searches a generated SQLite product index, reads selected-project Docker/Host context, answers troubleshooting questions, and opens Settings lenses. A PEP 517 build hook now generates the index for wheels, source archives, and editable installs; clean isolated package builds verify each path. Select 13 collected Python tests in settings tools and product index plus exact harness and package audit cases, 15 assistant component tests, the one assistant stabilization journey across eight permanent desktop/mobile Chromium/WebKit profiles, and three project execution mode journeys in assistant-real-desktop and assistant-real-webkit-320. The 14 browser cases exercise the production bundle and real Core on LAN where applicable.
exclusions: No native code changed. Unrelated Python, frontend, and browser journeys and full suites are excluded. The build hook is verified by manual isolated package builds, not a release-wide packaging suite. No physical phone or Safari device was available. Browser fixture Core processes and the throwaway are separate from the production Core.
